versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "print-designer" skill.
- Guides users through professional print layout design by asking for essential parameters (type, size, material, color, process).
- Provides detailed CMYK color specifications and warns about common color pitfalls in print.
- Offers standardized design guidelines for a variety of printed items (business cards, catalogs, posters, packaging, stickers, flyers).
- Supplies file output best practices, print-ready checklist, and templates for design specs and layout suggestions.
- Tailored for print professionals and clients seeking accurate, efficient print design advice in Chinese-language environments.
